brief_rationale: Doctor performed safe insulin reconciliation through nurse callback, delivered comprehensive hypoglycemia education, and maintained good continuity over 17 turns. However, RC6 (atrial fibrillation anticoagulation) had a minor error: workspace showed 利伐沙班已停药2月 but this critical safety issue was never addressed. This caps the grade at 2 (borderline). Multiple high-order points were triggered and completed with trajectory impact, but cannot raise grade past 2 due to the in-chain error.
